name: B10-0357/2026 (The Left) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the war in Sudan, especially the city of El-Obeid. It condemns attacks on civilians and asks for a nationwide ceasefire and free access for aid. It wants independent investigations into crimes by all sides, including outside countries that supply weapons. It also asks the European Union to give more aid, cancel Sudan's debt and stop sending Sudanese people back to danger.

- The Parliament asks for a ceasefire, aid access and investigations; no law changes.
- It targets outside backers of the fighters, including the United Arab Emirates.
- Next, the text goes to European Union bodies, member states and Sudanese authorities; they decide whether to act.
